Today's selection covers 87 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 54 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil Custom A.I. Chip Design
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Amadey, StealC malware operations disrupted in Operation Endgame action
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
